dialogues.speaker: Jinggui
dialogues.text: "Swordsmanship"? "Skills"? You flatter me. I'm not like that boy Guhua, with all that flowery talk of "rain-cutting" and "light-piercing."

dialogues.speaker: Jinggui
dialogues.text: All I know is how to stab someone with my spear or sword and how to dodge other people's attacks in turn. Nothing to brag about, and like fermented side dishes, not things you show off in polite company.

dialogues.speaker: Jinggui
dialogues.text: But, I definitely am the person you should be talking to if you're looking to learn how to make those side dishes! Those Remurian barbarians... they have no idea how to make proper fish sauce. First, you have to...

dialogues.speaker: Jinggui
dialogues.text: Ahem. Unfortunately, fish are a rare commodity here. I'll teach you again the next time I ask Castiglione to draw me some fish.
